svg.aria-label: 01 edi-x12-toolkit. Problem: Trading partners reject files, and the rejection rarely says why. Support time goes into guessing. Decision: Read the format the way the standard defines it, and explain every error in plain words. Outcome: Problems surface before a partner sees them. Anyone can try it in a browser, nothing to install.
